name: The Dolphin Mandate
worldConcept: The world is a post-flood oceanic civilization ruled by dolphins who enforce strict ecological laws. A human survivor is taken into their custody and required to build a new underwater city. He must use only dolphin-approved tools, materials, and techniques. Human technology, extraction, or resource manipulation is forbidden. The dolphins distrust humans and treat him as indebted. His survival depends on adapting to dolphin systems, navigating their political and ecological pressures, and proving he can build without harming the ocean.
